title: Small local model of an essentially smooth algebra
statement: Let R:Type u be a commutative ring and D:Type v a commutative local Artinian R-algebra. If D is essentially smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], then for every universe w there exists a commutative local Artinian R-algebra D':Type(max u w), essentially smooth over R, and an R-algebra isomorphism D to D'.

source.place: Lemma 07FJ, lemma-resolve-general, step 25; Algebra Definition 00QM and finite-presentation models

proof.text: Unpack EssentiallySmooth: choose its smooth model P, denominator submonoid S, and D isomorphic over R to Localization S. Smooth implies finite type. FiniteType.small makes P small in max u w; IsLocalization.mk'_surjective and small_of_surjective make Localization S and then D small in that universe.
Take D'=Shrink D, give it the transported ring and R-algebra structures, and construct the R-algebra equivalence. RingEquiv.isLocalRing and RingEquiv.isArtinianRing transport the two properties.

Shrink P to Q and transport its R-algebra structure and smoothness using Smooth.of_equiv. Pull S back along Q isomorphic to P, and construct the localization ring equivalence with ringEquivOfRingEquiv. It is an R-algebra equivalence because on scalars both sides are the base equivalence's commutation law followed by the scalar tower. Compose this with D' isomorphic to D and the original presentation. The resulting smooth model lives in max u w.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_essentiallySmooth_small_local_model
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (D : Type v) [CommRing D] [Algebra R D]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] (hsmooth : EssentiallySmooth R D) :
    ∃ (D' : Type (max u w)) (_ : CommRing D') (_ : Algebra R D')
      (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D'),
      EssentiallySmooth R D' ∧ Nonempty (D ≃ₐ[R] D')
